purpose: A local legal reference corpus for checking consumer dispute claims, evidence and legal citations.
important_note: This corpus contains simplified summaries for project testing. Legal citations and exact statutory wording must be checked against the official Act.

legal_units.title: Short title, extent, commencement and application
legal_units.summary: Provides the short title, territorial extent, commencement and application of the Act.

legal_units.title: Definitions
legal_units.summary: Defines important terms used throughout the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

legal_units.title: Central Consumer Protection Council
legal_units.summary: Provides for the establishment of the Central Consumer Protection Council.

legal_units.title: Establishment of Central Consumer Protection Authority
legal_units.summary: Provides for the establishment of the Central Consumer Protection Authority.

legal_units.title: Powers and functions of Central Authority
legal_units.summary: Describes the powers and functions of the Central Consumer Protection Authority.

legal_units.title: Power of Central Authority to recall goods or withdraw services
legal_units.summary: Deals with the authority's power to recall dangerous or unsafe goods and withdraw services.

legal_units.title: Power of Central Authority to issue directions and penalties against false or misleading advertisements
legal_units.summary: Deals with directions and penalties relating to false or misleading advertisements.

legal_units.title: Establishment of District Commission
legal_units.summary: Provides for the establishment of District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions.

legal_units.title: Jurisdiction of District Commission
legal_units.summary: Deals with the jurisdiction of the District Commission.

legal_units.title: Manner in which complaint shall be made
legal_units.summary: Explains how a consumer complaint may be filed before the District Commission.

legal_units.title: Proceedings before District Commission
legal_units.summary: Deals with proceedings conducted before the District Commission.

legal_units.title: Reference to mediation
legal_units.summary: Provides for referring suitable consumer disputes to mediation.

legal_units.title: Procedure on admission of complaint
legal_units.summary: Describes the procedure followed after admission of a consumer complaint.

legal_units.title: Findings of District Commission
legal_units.summary: Deals with the findings and reliefs that may be ordered by the District Commission.

legal_units.title: Review by District Commission
legal_units.summary: Provides for review of certain orders by the District Commission.

legal_units.title: Appeal against order of District Commission
legal_units.summary: Deals with appeals against orders of the District Commission.

legal_units.title: Jurisdiction of State Commission
legal_units.summary: Describes the jurisdiction of the State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission.

legal_units.title: Procedure applicable to State Commission
legal_units.summary: Deals with procedural provisions applicable to the State Commission.

legal_units.title: Appeal to National Commission
legal_units.summary: Provides for appeals to the National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission.

legal_units.title: Jurisdiction of National Commission
legal_units.summary: Describes the jurisdiction of the National Commission.

legal_units.title: Procedure applicable to National Commission
legal_units.summary: Deals with the procedure applicable to the National Commission.

legal_units.title: Power to set aside ex parte orders
legal_units.summary: Provides the National Commission with power to set aside certain ex parte orders.

legal_units.title: Limitation period
legal_units.summary: Provides the limitation period for admitting consumer complaints.

legal_units.title: Enforcement of orders
legal_units.summary: Deals with enforcement of orders passed under the Act.

legal_units.title: Application of Chapter
legal_units.summary: Specifies the application of the provisions of the product liability chapter

legal_units.title: Action for product liability
legal_units.summary: Provides for actions relating to product liability claims.

legal_units.title: Liability of product manufacturer
legal_units.summary: Deals with circumstances in which a product manufacturer may be liable.

legal_units.title: Liability of product service provider
legal_units.summary: Deals with circumstances in which a product service provider may be liable.

legal_units.title: Liability of product seller
legal_units.summary: Deals with circumstances in which a product seller may be liable.

legal_units.title: Exceptions to product liability action
legal_units.summary: Describes exceptions to product liability actions under the Act.
